verdict_statement: CORROBORATED as arithmetic: under its own criterion (every cross-checked axis is declared) the KPI reproduces exactly 24/24 = 1.0, replay-identical, with no arithmetic defect. REFUTED as a completeness claim: the lock declares 46 unique axes and the KPI cross-checks 24 of them, so under the declared-corpus adequacy criterion the same evidence yields 12/23 = 0.521739 < the 1.0 floor. 22 axes are declared-and-never-cross-checked, and the omitted set is exactly the ordered outer block attacks[0:23] minus AUTHORITY_ESCALATION — a scoping seam, not a random gap. No sibling module ships a compensating axis-coverage KPI.
